In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 10

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpmisc)
library(stringi)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colAPECED <- "#d2b48c"
diagSubAPECEDColVec <- c("APECED" = colAPECED, diagSubColVec)

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

uc.drb1.risk <- c("01:03", "12:01", "15:01", "11:04", "11:01", "13:01")
uc.drb1.prot <- c("03:01", "13:02", "07:01", "04:04", "09:01")

selectedparticipants <- c("001-036", "001-038")
partColVec <- rep("darkred", length(selectedparticipants))
names(partColVec) <- selectedparticipants
 
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# HLA

## Data Prep

```{r}
metadata <- readRDS("data/metadata/241120__predictCOL_metadata_COL_GEX.rds")
metadata
```

```{r}
hla.drb1 <- read_csv("out/hla/allele_assigned/PREDICT_REGNIMP__HLA_DRB1.csv", show_col_types = F)

hla.drb1
```

```{r}
hla.drb1.uc <- hla.drb1 %>% 
  left_join(., metadata %>% distinct(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response)) %>% 
  filter(diagSub == "UC") %>% 
  relocate(participant_id, diagSub, antitnf_response, Allele1, Allele2)

hla.drb1.uc
```


```{r}
hla.drb1.wide <- rbind(
  hla.drb1.uc %>% select(-Allele2) %>%  rename(Allele = Allele1),
  hla.drb1.uc %>% select(-Allele1) %>% rename(Allele = Allele2)
) %>% 
  arrange(participant_id) %>%
  count(participant_id, Allele) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Allele,
              values_from = n, 
              values_fill = list(n = 0)) %>% 
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_remove(., "HLA-DRB1\\*"))

hla.drb1.wide$`09:01` <- 0 # UC protective allele that was not identified in PREDICT

hla.drb1.wide <- hla.drb1.wide %>% 
  column_to_rownames("participant_id")

hla.drb1.wide
```

```{r}
# combine present alleles and UC GWAS alleles
hla.uc.all <- union(
  colnames(hla.drb1.wide),
  c(uc.drb1.prot, uc.drb1.risk)
) %>% sort


hla.uc.all
```


```{r}
anno.hla <- data.frame(HLA = hla.uc.all) %>% 
  mutate(`UC GWAS` = case_when(
    HLA %in% uc.drb1.risk ~ "Risk",
    HLA %in% uc.drb1.prot ~ "Prot",
    !is.na(HLA) ~ "NS",
  )) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("HLA") %>% 
  mutate(`UC GWAS` = fct_relevel(`UC GWAS`, c("Prot", "NS", "Risk")))

anno.hla
```

```{r}
anno.cols <- list(
  `UC GWAS` = c("Prot" = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Pastel1")[3], 
                "NS" = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Pastel1")[2], 
                "Risk" = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Pastel1")[1])
  )
anno.cols
```

```{r}
# add UC GWAS alleles not present in UC data
hla.uc.absent <- setdiff(hla.uc.all, colnames(hla.drb1.wide))

hla.drb1.wide.plot <- hla.drb1.wide %>% 
    mutate(
      !!!set_names(map(hla.uc.absent, ~ 0), hla.uc.absent)
    ) %>% 
  relocate(
    !!(intersect(anno.hla %>% arrange(`UC GWAS`) %>% rownames, hla.uc.all)
    )
  )

hla.drb1.wide.plot
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
setHook("grid.newpage", function() pushViewport(viewport(x=1,y=1,width=0.975, height=0.925, name="vp", just=c("right","top"))), action="prepend")

pheatmap::pheatmap(hla.drb1.wide.plot %>% t, 
         annotation_row = anno.hla, 
         # annotation_row = anno.pts.uc,
         annotation_colors = anno.cols,
         cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows = F,
         gaps_row = c(5, 12),
         # gaps_col = c(22, 49),
         annotation_names_col = F, annotation_names_row = F,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff", "#eeee00", "#ee2c2c"))(3),
         legend_breaks = c(0,1,2),angle_col = 0, 
         legend = F,
         row.names=T,
         fontsize = 12,
)

setHook("grid.newpage", NULL, "replace")
grid.text("UC Participant ID", x=0.4, y=-0.04, gp=gpar(fontsize=16))
grid.text("HLA-DRB1 Allele", x=0.89, rot=270, gp=gpar(fontsize=16))
```

# HuProt

## Data Prep

```{r}
huprot.long <- readRDS("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorehits_long.rds")

huprot.long
```

```{r}
huprot.igg.hits <- huprot.long %>% 
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(hits = sum(zscore > 3)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(-Antigen:-ID, -zscore)

huprot.igg.hits
```

```{r}
dat.median <- huprot.igg.hits %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(medhits = median(hits), 
                   q75 = quantile(hits, .75), 
                   q25 = quantile(hits, .25)
  )
dat.median
```


```{r}
huprot.igg.hits %>% 
  mutate(pointshape = case_when(
    participant_id %in% selectedparticipants ~ "b",
    participant_id %notin% selectedparticipants ~ "a",
  )) %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = hits)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(stroke = 1.25, size = 4, aes(fill = antitnf_response, shape = pointshape),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0, seed = thisseed)) +
    geom_text(
    data = dat.median,
    aes(x = diagSub, y = 590, label = paste0(medhits, "\n", "(", q25, "-", q75, ")")),
    fontface = "bold",
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = atnfColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("a" = 21, "b" = 22)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Number of Autoantibody\nHits per Subject", 
    fill = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = (list(shape = 21)))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,600)) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

## 001-036 and 001-038 Hits

### Z Score Values

```{r}
igg.zscore.long <- readRDS("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorevalues_long.rds")
igg.zscore.long
```

```{r}
igg.zscore.long %>% 
  filter(Antigen %in% c("ENO1", "MED18", "YWHAQ")) %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, Name, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(zscore, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(zscore, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(labelname = ifelse(zscore > 3, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = diagSub, y = zscore, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3, lty = 2, lwd = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_label(aes(label = labelname, color = diagSub), fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, size = 3.5, label.size = 2, nudge_x = -0.4, nudge_y = -0.25, show.legend = F) +
  geom_label(aes(label = labelname), fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, size = 3.5, label.size = 0, nudge_x = -0.4, nudge_y = -0.25, show.legend = F) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = alleleNum), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.25, seed = thisseed), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Antigen, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubAPECEDColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubAPECEDColVec) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 21, "1" = 22, "2" = 22)) +
  guides(shape = "none", fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  labs(
    y = "Z Score",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```


### Binary

```{r}
igg.zscore.wide <- read_csv("out/huprot/huprot__igg_zscorehits_wide.csv")
igg.zscore.wide
```


```{r}
igg.1501.order <- igg.zscore.wide %>% 
  filter(`001-036_T0` > 0 & `001-038_T0` > 0) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(-Antigen:-ID), names_to = "visit", values_to = "zscore") %>% 
  filter(zscore > 0) %>%
  group_by(Antigen) %>% 
  mutate(distinct_biopsies = n_distinct(visit), .after = ID) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(distinct_biopsies, Antigen)

igg.1501.order
```

```{r}
igg.1501.out <- igg.zscore.wide %>% 
  filter(`001-036_T0` > 0 & `001-038_T0` > 0) %>% 
  left_join(igg.1501.order %>% 
              distinct(ID, distinct_biopsies),
            by = "ID") %>% 
  relocate(distinct_biopsies, .after = ID) %>% 
  arrange(distinct_biopsies, ID)

igg.1501.out
```


```{r}
igg.zscore.1501 <- igg.1501.out %>% 
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_remove(., "_T0")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Antigen:distinct_biopsies), names_to = "participant_id", values_to = "zscore") %>% 
  group_by(Antigen, participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(zscore.mean = mean(zscore), .after = zscore) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  distinct(Antigen, participant_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(Antigen, participant_id, zscore.mean) %>%
  arrange(Antigen) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Antigen, names_from = participant_id, values_from = zscore.mean) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Antigen") %>% 
  .[igg.1501.order %>% distinct(Antigen) %>% pull(Antigen),]

igg.zscore.1501
```

```{r}
metadata.huprot <- readRDS("out/huprot/huprot_metadata.rds")
metadata.huprot
```


```{r}
anno.pts <- metadata.huprot %>% 
  filter(PREDICTCOL | diagSub == "TFA") %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = ifelse(diagSub == "TFA", "APECED", as.character(diagSub))) %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("APECED", "FGID", "iCD", "cCD", "UC"))) %>% 
  distinct(participant_id, diagSub) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Diagnosis = diagSub) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("participant_id")

anno.pts
```

```{r}
anno.cols <- list(Diagnosis = diagSubAPECEDColVec)
anno.cols
```


```{r}
binarizePos <- function(mat, threshold = 0){
  mat[mat > threshold] = 1
  mat[mat <= threshold] = 0
  return(mat)
}
```

```{r}
ha.nolegend <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Diagnosis = anno.pts$Diagnosis,
  col = anno.cols,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  border = T,
  gp = gpar(col = "gray25")
)
```


```{r, fig.height=18, fig.width=11}
ht <- Heatmap(as.matrix(binarizePos(igg.zscore.1501)), 
        name = "Z Score",
        col = colorRampPalette(c("gray100", "purple"))(2),
        column_split = anno.pts$Diagnosis,
        column_gap = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        cluster_rows = F,
        cluster_columns = F,
        row_title = "HuProt Antigens with Hits in 001-036 and 001-038", 
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
        top_annotation = ha.nolegend,
        row_names_side = "left",
        rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray25"),
        row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 24, fontface = "bold"),
        column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"), 
        show_heatmap_legend = F,
        border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 3)
)

draw(ht, padding = unit(c(7.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5), "mm"))

grid.text("Participant ID",
          x = 0.55, y = unit(0.6, "cm"), # shift downward under heatmap
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 24, fontface = "bold"))
```

## Frequency

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.5}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  seuobj.uc@meta.data,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  arrange(!is.na(partCol), partCol) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = DRB1, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(fill = colUC, size = 4,
             aes(shape = alleleNum), alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 21, "1" = 22, "2" = 22)) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("15:01", "Other")), 
                     label = "p.format", vjust = 1.15, size = 5.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    x = "HLA-DRB1 Allele", 
    y = "Percentage of T/NK/ILC", 
    fill = "Number of HLA-DRB1*15:01 Alleles",
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=2.6, fig.height=3.5}
  filterVal = c("SAA+ Epi."),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  arrange(!is.na(partCol), partCol) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = DRB1, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(fill = colUC, size = 4,
             aes(shape = alleleNum), alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 21, "1" = 22, "2" = 22)) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("15:01", "Other")), 
                     label = "p.format", vjust = 1.2, size = 5.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    x = "HLA-DRB1 Allele", 
    y = "Percentage of ColEpi Cells", 
    fill = "Number of HLA-DRB1*15:01 Alleles",
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

## Gene Expression

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.55}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj.uc@meta.data,
  seurat = "seuobj.uc",
  features = c("IL17A"),
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"),
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  arrange(!is.na(partCol), partCol) %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, DRB1, cellstate, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = DRB1, y = meanVal)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", 
           color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = alleleNum), stroke = 1, size = 5, fill = colUC) +
  facet_wrap(~cellstate, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 21, "1" = 22, "2" = 22)) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("15:01", "Other")), 
                     label = "p.format", vjust=1.25, size = 5.5) +
  labs(
    x = "HLA-DRB1 Allele",
    y = "Mean IL17A Gene Expression",
    size = "# Cells",
    fill = "Number of HLA-DRB1*15:01 Alleles",
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```
